description: Every bearer of an occurring thought exists at the selected world w: the bearer exercises intellect in it, intellectual exercise requires act in some respect, act in some respect implies act of esse (q.4 a.1 ad 3 reading), and act of esse suffices for existence at w (OPEN converse of the esse contract). The last premise carries the world-indexing; without it the bearer may be in act of esse and fail to exist at w.
